shownContainmentGuidance.headline: Keep the fixture contained while we prepare the next step.
shownContainmentGuidance.intro: A small faucet drip is usually manageable for the moment when you keep water use limited and the area dry.

steps.title: Use the fixture as little as possible
steps.detail: Reducing water use lowers the chance that the drip worsens while you move through the request.

steps.title: Place a towel or bowl under the drip
steps.detail: This helps protect the counter or cabinet area from steady moisture.

shownContainmentGuidance.reassurance: You are taking the right first step. We will keep the next screen short and practical.

shownRequestReviewSummary.intro: This is a quick final check of what we will submit, what timing usually looks like, and how pricing is handled before any additional work is approved.

items.label: Is the dripping coming from one faucet only?

eta.label: Estimated response window

pricing.label: Pricing expectation

pricing.detail: If repair work is needed beyond the initial assessment, the scope and added cost are confirmed before you approve anything else.
